title: Braelon Allen makes emphatic Jets return with 31-yard touchdown after 11-month layoff

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Braelon Allen makes emphatic Jets return with 31-yard touchdown after 11-month layoff
sources.description: Jets running back Braelon Allen returned from an 11-month injury layoff to score an impressive 31-yard touchdown against the Buccaneers.
